title: Manager - Cloud Operations
description:

Primary MySQL DB Support:


* 10\+years of experience as a MySQL DBA (as primary)
* Secondary database knowledge of Postgres database preferred
* A Good Knowledge of MySQL database replication
* Sound Knowledge on MySQL InnoDB cluster configuration/troubleshooting
* Sound knowledge on Percona Tools / cluster configurations and troubleshooting
* Sound Knowledge on MEM and MEB
* Optimize MySQL database performance

Installing and Configuring PostgreSQL from source or packages on Linux machines. DB optimization and troubleshooting

title: Admissions Assistant
description:
The Office Administration \& Admission Assistant manages daily clerical functions and student enrollment activities. Positioned along the Tamil Nadu–Kerala border near Walayar, this role serves as a primary point of contact for prospective students and parents from both regions. The position requires seamless bilingual communication (Malayalam and Tamil/English) to assist families through the admission funnel while maintaining organized administrative records.

**1\. Admissions \& Student Outreach**

* Address inquiries from walk\-in visitors, phone calls, and online leads from candidates across Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
* Assist prospective students and parents with application forms, course criteria, fee structures, and required document submissions.
* Coordinate student campus tours, walk\-in counseling sessions, and promotional admission events.
* Follow up with prospective candidates to track lead status and facilitate timely admission completions.

**2\. General Office Administration**

* Manage front\-desk operations, maintain visitor logs, and route incoming correspondence to relevant department heads.
* Maintain organized physical files and digital databases for student records, admission documents, and administrative files.
* Prepare official letters, certificates, transfer records, and routine campus correspondence.
* Oversee inventory supplies for administrative stationery, office equipment, and promotional admissions collateral.

**3\. Cross\-Border \& Regional Coordination**

* Communicate fluently with students and guardians from Palakkad, Ernakulam, and neighboring Kerala regions in Malayalam, while handling local Tamil Nadu queries in Tamil or English.
* Assist students with inter\-state document verification, including migration certificates, board equivalencies, and regional scholarship applications.
* Liaise with transport and hostel management teams to provide accurate logistics details to outstation students.

Pay: ₹14,078\.80 \- ₹17,500\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Admission Counsellor
description:
Academic Counselor

**Company:** IPCS Global  
**Location:** Tambaram  
**Salary:** ₹18,000 – ₹25,000 per month  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Location:** In\-person

Job Overview

IPCS Global is looking for a motivated and student\-focused **Academic Counselor** to join our team in **Tambaram**. The candidate will be responsible for counseling students and parents, handling inquiries, generating leads, following up with prospective students, and converting qualified leads into admissions.

Key Responsibilities

* Counsel students and parents regarding courses, career opportunities, and educational programs.
* Handle walk\-in, telephone, WhatsApp, and online inquiries.
* Understand student requirements and recommend suitable courses.
* Generate leads through inquiries, referrals, and promotional activities.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with prospective students.
* Convert qualified leads into admissions.
* Achieve monthly admission and sales targets.
* Maintain accurate student and lead information in the CRM.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with students and parents.
* Participate in seminars, workshops, and promotional activities.
* Prepare regular follow\-up, lead, and admission reports.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth admission process.

Requirements \& Skills

* **Minimum 1 year of experience in an EdTech firm is mandatory.**
* Prior experience in **Academic Counseling, Admission Counseling, Inside Sales, or Student Counseling** is preferred.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong counseling, convincing, and negotiation skills.
* Good sales and follow\-up abilities.
* Target\-oriented and self\-motivated.
* Strong relationship management skills.
* Good listening and problem\-solving abilities.
* Empathetic and student\-focused approach.
* Basic knowledge of CRM systems and educational programs.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month
